description_scope: IFC entity semantics only; no claim of actual field availability

View_ActionRequest.description: An IfcActionRequest is a request for an action to fulfill a need.

View_Actor.description: The IfcActor defines all actors or human agents involved in a project during its full life cycle.

View_Annotation.description: A graphical annotation that adds notes or meaning to objects within the project's geometric and spatial context.

View_Asset.description: An identifiable group of elements treated as one asset with financial value.

View_Beam.description: An individual beam, usually horizontal or nearly horizontal. It is not necessarily load bearing.

View_Building.description: A structure intended to shelter occupants or contents and normally remain permanently in one place.

View_BuildingElementPart.description: Layers or major components as subordinate parts of a building element.

View_BuildingElementProxy.description: An element represented without a more specific predefined semantic class for the element it represents.

View_BuildingStorey.description: The building storey has an elevation and typically represents a (nearly) horizontal aggregation of spaces that are vertically bound.

View_ChamferEdgeFeature.description: An edge feature with a chamfered cross section shape.

View_Column.description: A usually vertical structural member that transfers forces to its base, primarily through compression.

View_Condition.description: An IfcCondition determines the state or condition of an element at a particular point in time.

View_ConditionCriterion.description: An IfcConditionCriterion is a particular measured or assessed criterion that contributes to the overall condition of an artifact.

View_ConstructionEquipmentResource.description: An IfcConstructionEquipmentResource is a type of construction equipment that is used as resource to assist in the performance of construction.

View_ConstructionMaterialResource.description: An IfcConstructionMaterialResource identifies a material resource type in a construction project.

View_ConstructionProductResource.description: An IfcConstructionProductResource defines the role of a product that is consumed (wholly or partially), or occupied (i.e. used) in the performance of construction.

View_CostItem.description: A cost or financial value with contextual information, used as an item within a cost schedule.

View_CostSchedule.description: A collection of cost items for an estimate, bill of quantities, work order, or another cost-related presentation.

View_Covering.description: A finishing or protective covering applied to a surface or element, such as flooring, ceiling, cladding, insulation, or roofing.

View_CrewResource.description: An IfcCrewResource represents a type of resource used in construction processes, i.e. construction crew resource.

View_CurtainWall.description: A non-load-bearing exterior wall that encloses a building.

View_DiscreteAccessory.description: Representation of different kinds of accessories included in or added to elements.

View_DistributionChamberElement.description: The IfcDistributionChamberElement defines a place at which distribution systems and their constituent elements may be inspected or through which they may travel.

View_DistributionControlElement.description: The distribution element IfcDistributionControlElement defines occurrence elements of a building automation control system that are used to impart control over elements of a distribution system.

View_DistributionElement.description: Generalization of all elements that participate in a distribution system.

View_DistributionFlowElement.description: The distribution element IfcDistributionFlowElement defines occurrence elements of a distribution system that facilitate the distribution of energy or matter, such as air, water or power.

View_DistributionPort.description: The product IfcDistributionPort defines the occurrence of a specialized port for use within the context of distribution elements.

View_Door.description: Construction for closing an opening, intended primarily for access with hinged, pivoted or sliding operation.

View_ElectricDistributionPoint.description: An IfcElectricDistributionPoint is a flow controller in which instances of electrical devices are brought together at a single place for a particular purpose.

View_ElectricalCircuit.description: An IfcElectricalCircuit defines a particular type of system that is for the purpose of distributing electrical power.

View_ElectricalElement.description: Generalization of all electrical related objects.

View_ElementAssembly.description: A container class that represents complex element assemblies aggregated from several elements, such as discrete elements, building elements, or other elements.

View_EnergyConversionDevice.description: A device within a distribution system that converts energy or transfers heat.

View_EquipmentElement.description: A premanufactured movable item of equipment that provides a building service or another servicing function.

View_EquipmentStandard.description: An IfcEquipmentStandard is a standard for equipment allocation that can be assigned to persons within an organization.

View_Fastener.description: Representations of fixing parts which are used as fasteners to connect or join elements with other elements.

View_FlowController.description: An element that regulates flow through a distribution system, such as a damper, valve, switch, or relay.

View_FlowFitting.description: The distribution flow element IfcFlowFitting defines the occurrence of a junction or transition in a flow distribution system (e.g., elbow, tee, etc.).

View_FlowMovingDevice.description: A device that moves or circulates a liquid or gas through a distribution system, such as a pump or fan.

View_FlowSegment.description: A typically straight, continuous, two-port section of a distribution system, such as a pipe or duct section.

View_FlowStorageDevice.description: A device used for temporary storage within a distribution system, such as a tank.

View_FlowTerminal.description: A permanently attached endpoint or starting point of a distribution system, such as an air outlet, drain, or sink.

View_FlowTreatmentDevice.description: A distribution-system device that removes unwanted material from a liquid or gas.

View_Footing.description: A part of the foundation of a structure that spreads and transmits the load directly to the soil.

View_FurnishingElement.description: Generalization of all furniture related objects.

View_FurnitureStandard.description: An IfcFurnitureStandard is a standard for furniture allocation that can be assigned to persons within an organization.

View_Grid.description: A planar design grid positioned in three-dimensional space to locate structural and other design elements.

View_Group.description: An arbitrary grouping of objects for a shared purpose or organizational context.

View_Inventory.description: An IfcInventory is a list of items within an enterprise.

View_LaborResource.description: An IfcLaborResource is used in construction with particular skills or crafts required to perform certain types of construction or management related work.

View_MechanicalFastener.description: A component that mechanically joins building elements or their parts.

View_Member.description: An IfcMember is a structural member designed to carry loads between or beyond points of support.

View_Move.description: An activity relocating people, organizational groups, or organizations together with their furniture and equipment.

View_Occupant.description: An actor identifying the form of occupancy of a property.

View_OpeningElement.description: The opening element stands for opening, recess or chase, all reflecting voids.

View_OrderAction.description: An IfcOrderAction is the point at which requests for work are received and processed within an organization.

View_PerformanceHistory.description: The IfcPerformanceHistory is used to document the actual performance of an occurrence instance over time.

View_Permit.description: An IfcPermit is a document that allows permission to carry out actions in places and on artifacts where security or other access restrictions apply.

View_Pile.description: A slender foundation member embedded into the ground to support a load.

View_Plate.description: An IfcPlate is a planar and often flat part with constant thickness.

View_Procedure.description: An IfcProcedure is an identifiable step to be taken within a process that is considered to occur over zero or a non-measurable period of time.

View_Project.description: The undertaking of some design, engineering, construction, or maintenance activities leading towards a product.

View_ProjectOrder.description: An IfcProjectOrder sets common properties for project orders issued in a construction or facilities management project.

View_ProjectOrderRecord.description: An IfcProjectOrderRecord records information in sequence about the incidence of each order that is connected with one or a set of objects.

View_ProjectionElement.description: The IfcProjectionElement is a specialization of the general feature element to represent projections applied to building elements.

View_Proxy.description: A generic container for an object described by associated properties, with optional geometric representation and spatial placement.

View_Railing.description: A frame assembly beside circulation spaces or boundaries, used in place of or together with walls.

View_Ramp.description: An inclined passage linking levels at different elevations.

View_RampFlight.description: A single inclined ramp segment connecting landings, floors, or slabs at different elevations.

View_ReinforcingBar.description: A steel bar, usually with manufactured deformations in the surface, used in concrete and masonry construction to provide additional strength.

View_ReinforcingMesh.description: A welded grid of longitudinal and transverse wires or bars, commonly used to reinforce concrete slabs.

View_Roof.description: The top covering of a building, protecting it from weather.

View_RoundedEdgeFeature.description: An edge feature with a rounded cross section shape.

View_ScheduleTimeControl.description: Time-related process information, including actual or scheduled start and finish times, duration, and float.

View_ServiceLife.description: An IfcServiceLife is the period of time that an artefact (typically a product or asset) will last.

View_Site.description: Area where construction works are undertaken.

View_Slab.description: A slab is a component of the construction that normally encloses a space vertically.

View_Space.description: A space represents an area or volume bounded actually or theoretically.

View_SpaceProgram.description: Architectural program for a space in the building or facility being designed; essentially the requirements definition for such a building space.

View_Stair.description: Construction comprising a succession of horizontal stages (steps or landings) that make it possible to pass on foot to other levels.

View_StairFlight.description: Assembly of building components in a single "run" of stair steps (not interrupted by a landing).

View_StructuralAnalysisModel.description: The IfcStructuralAnalysisModel is used to assemble all information needed to represent a structural analysis model.

View_StructuralCurveConnection.description: A linear structural-analysis connection or support where surface members meet along an edge.

View_StructuralCurveMember.description: A linear structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a beam, column, or rod.

View_StructuralLinearAction.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralLinearAction are used to define constant linear actions.

View_StructuralLoadGroup.description: The entity IfcStructuralLoadGroup is used to structure the physical impacts.

View_StructuralPlanarAction.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralPlanarAction are used to define constant planar actions.

View_StructuralPointAction.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralPointAction are used to define point actions.

View_StructuralPointConnection.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralPointConnection shall be used to describe structural nodes or point supports.

View_StructuralPointReaction.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralPointReaction are used to define point reactions.

View_StructuralResultGroup.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralResultGroup are used to group results of structural analysis calculations and to capture the connection to the underlying basic load group.

View_StructuralSurfaceConnection.description: A surface structural-analysis connection or support where members meet over a face.

View_StructuralSurfaceMember.description: A surface structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a slab, wall, or shell.

View_SubContractResource.description: An IfcSubContractResource is a construction resource needed in a construction process that represents a type of sub-contractor.

View_System.description: A collection of related parts organized to perform a common function or provide a service.

View_Task.description: An IfcTask is an identifiable unit of work to be carried out independently of any other units of work in a construction project.

View_Tendon.description: A tensioned steel wire, cable, bar, rod, or strand used to prestress concrete.

View_TendonAnchor.description: In prestressed or posttensioned concrete, the end connection for the tendons.

View_TimeSeriesSchedule.description: The IfcTimeSeriesSchedule defines a time-series that is applicable to to one or more calendar dates.

View_TransportElement.description: Generalization of all transport related objects that move people, animals or goods within a building or building complex.

View_VirtualElement.description: A special element used to provide imaginary boundaries, such as between two adjacent, but not separated, spaces.

View_Wall.description: Vertical construction usually in masonry or in concrete which bounds or subdivides a construction works and fulfills a load bearing or retaining function.

View_Window.description: Construction for closing a vertical or near vertical opening in a wall or pitched roof that will admit light and may admit fresh air.

View_WorkPlan.description: An IfcWorkPlan represents work plans in a construction or a facilities management project.

View_WorkSchedule.description: An IfcWorkSchedule represents a task schedule in a work plan, which in turn can contain a set of schedules for different purposes.

View_Zone.description: A zone (IfcZone) is an aggregation of spaces, partial spaces or other zones.

IfcMechanicalFastener.description: A component that mechanically joins building elements or their parts.

IfcMove.description: An activity relocating people, organizational groups, or organizations together with their furniture and equipment.

IfcObject.description: An IfcObject is the generalization of any semantically treated thing or process.

IfcObjectDefinition.description: A general semantic definition of an object or process, including object occurrences and object types.

IfcOccupant.description: An actor identifying the form of occupancy of a property.

IfcOpeningElement.description: The opening element stands for opening, recess or chase, all reflecting voids.

IfcOrderAction.description: An IfcOrderAction is the point at which requests for work are received and processed within an organization.

IfcPlate.description: An IfcPlate is a planar and often flat part with constant thickness.

IfcPort.description: An IfcPort provides the means for an element to connect to other elements.

IfcProcedure.description: An IfcProcedure is an identifiable step to be taken within a process that is considered to occur over zero or a non-measurable period of time.

IfcProcess.description: An activity in construction, design, costing, procurement, maintenance, or a related process.

IfcProduct.description: Any object, or any aid to define, organize and annotate an object, that relates to a geometric or spatial context.

IfcProject.description: The undertaking of some design, engineering, construction, or maintenance activities leading towards a product.

IfcProjectOrderRecord.description: An IfcProjectOrderRecord records information in sequence about the incidence of each order that is connected with one or a set of objects.

IfcRamp.description: An inclined passage linking levels at different elevations.

IfcReinforcingElement.description: A component embedded in concrete so that it acts together with the concrete to resist forces.

IfcReinforcingMesh.description: A welded grid of longitudinal and transverse wires or bars, commonly used to reinforce concrete slabs.

IfcResource.description: The IfcResource contains the information needed to represent the costs, schedule, and other impacts from the use of a thing in a process.

IfcRoof.description: The top covering of a building, protecting it from weather.

IfcRoundedEdgeFeature.description: An edge feature with a rounded cross section shape.

IfcScheduleTimeControl.description: Time-related process information, including actual or scheduled start and finish times, duration, and float.

IfcServiceLife.description: An IfcServiceLife is the period of time that an artefact (typically a product or asset) will last.

IfcSlab.description: A slab is a component of the construction that normally encloses a space vertically.

IfcSpace.description: A space represents an area or volume bounded actually or theoretically.

IfcSpaceProgram.description: Architectural program for a space in the building or facility being designed; essentially the requirements definition for such a building space.

IfcSpatialStructureElement.description: A spatial structure element (IfcSpatialStructureElement) is the generalization of all spatial elements that might be used to define a spatial structure.

IfcStairFlight.description: Assembly of building components in a single "run" of stair steps (not interrupted by a landing).

IfcStructuralAction.description: A structural action is a structural activity that acts upon a structural item or building element.

IfcStructuralActivity.description: A structural action or reaction, such as a load, displacement, support reaction, internal force, or deflection.

IfcStructuralAnalysisModel.description: The IfcStructuralAnalysisModel is used to assemble all information needed to represent a structural analysis model.

IfcStructuralConnection.description: The abstract entity IfcStructuralConnection is the superclass of entities representing structural supports or connecting elements (nodes).

IfcStructuralCurveConnection.description: A linear structural-analysis connection or support where surface members meet along an edge.

IfcStructuralCurveMember.description: A linear structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a beam, column, or rod.

IfcStructuralCurveMemberVarying.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralCurveMemberVarying shall be used to describe linear structural elements with varying profile properties.

IfcStructuralItem.description: An abstract structural-analysis item covering structural members and structural connections and their associations with structural actions.

IfcStructuralLinearAction.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralLinearAction are used to define constant linear actions.

IfcStructuralLinearActionVarying.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralLinearActionVarying are used to define varying linear actions.

IfcStructuralLoadGroup.description: The entity IfcStructuralLoadGroup is used to structure the physical impacts.

IfcStructuralMember.description: The abstract entity IfcStructuralMember is the superclass of all structural elements representing the structural behavior of building elements.

IfcStructuralPlanarAction.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralPlanarAction are used to define constant planar actions.

IfcStructuralPlanarActionVarying.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralPlanarActionVarying are used to define varying planar actions.

IfcStructuralPointAction.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralPointAction are used to define point actions.

IfcStructuralPointConnection.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralPointConnection shall be used to describe structural nodes or point supports.

IfcStructuralPointReaction.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralPointReaction are used to define point reactions.

IfcStructuralReaction.description: A structural reaction is a structural activity that results from a structural action imposed to a structural item or building element.

IfcStructuralResultGroup.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralResultGroup are used to group results of structural analysis calculations and to capture the connection to the underlying basic load group.

IfcStructuralSurfaceConnection.description: A surface structural-analysis connection or support where members meet over a face.

IfcStructuralSurfaceMember.description: A surface structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a slab, wall, or shell.

IfcStructuralSurfaceMemberVarying.description: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralSurfaceMemberVarying shall be used to describe planar structural elements with a varying thickness.

IfcSubContractResource.description: An IfcSubContractResource is a construction resource needed in a construction process that represents a type of sub-contractor.

IfcSystem.description: A collection of related parts organized to perform a common function or provide a service.

IfcTask.description: An IfcTask is an identifiable unit of work to be carried out independently of any other units of work in a construction project.

IfcTendon.description: A tensioned steel wire, cable, bar, rod, or strand used to prestress concrete.

IfcTendonAnchor.description: In prestressed or posttensioned concrete, the end connection for the tendons.

IfcTimeSeriesSchedule.description: The IfcTimeSeriesSchedule defines a time-series that is applicable to to one or more calendar dates.

IfcTransportElement.description: Generalization of all transport related objects that move people, animals or goods within a building or building complex.

IfcVirtualElement.description: A special element used to provide imaginary boundaries, such as between two adjacent, but not separated, spaces.

IfcWall.description: Vertical construction usually in masonry or in concrete which bounds or subdivides a construction works and fulfills a load bearing or retaining function.

IfcWallStandardCase.description: The standard wall (IfcWallStandardCase) defines a wall with certain constraints for the provision of parameters and with certain constraints for the geometric representation.

IfcWindow.description: Construction for closing a vertical or near vertical opening in a wall or pitched roof that will admit light and may admit fresh air.

IfcWorkControl.description: An IfcWorkControl is an abstract supertype which captures information that is common to both IfcWorkPlan and IfcWorkSchedule.

IfcWorkPlan.description: An IfcWorkPlan represents work plans in a construction or a facilities management project.

IfcWorkSchedule.description: An IfcWorkSchedule represents a task schedule in a work plan, which in turn can contain a set of schedules for different purposes.

IfcZone.description: A zone (IfcZone) is an aggregation of spaces, partial spaces or other zones.
